result.topic_en: Basic properties of the residues of the powers of a number a divided by a prime P: there are at most P−1 distinct nonzero residues, so they must recur; each residue gives the next one; and the integers fall into P classes according to their residue mod P.

items.english: No more than P−1 distinct residues can occur. Therefore, since the series of residues is infinite, the same residues must recur in it repeatedly.
